note: BH-8030: how long the hub waits for a queued or claimed pool row of a console head. Past it the hub closes the row failed and reads it as the box's fault (no charge to the head, one console-preview-box alert); the next tick queues a new row. Read as ${CONSOLE_PREVIEW_POOL_TIMEOUT_S:-3600}; a non-number or 0 is one log line and the default.
